fields.label: API Key
fields.description: API key for the selected provider.

fields.label: Model (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use the provider default. Examples — Claude: claude-sonnet-4-6, Groq: llama-3.3-70b-versatile

Refuse a new Purchase Order for a supplier who already holds an advance paid against an earlier order that has not been invoiced yet. The buyer is warned as soon as the supplier is chosen, and the order cannot be saved.
fields.label: Block New Purchase Order When Supplier Holds an Unbilled Advance

fields.description: Advances at or below this figure are ignored, in company currency. Leave at 0 to block on any amount at all — note that catches trivial balances and invites the override to be clicked through out of habit.
fields.label: Ignore Advances Up To

fields.description: Roles or individual users who may raise the order anyway. Everyone else is stopped. Administrator always may.
fields.label: Allowed to Override

fields.description: Limit how far back a document may be dated. Off by default; nothing is enforced until a rule below names the doctype.
fields.label: Restrict Backdated Entries

fields.description: Applied to a user who matches no rule for a doctype that has rules. -1 leaves them unrestricted; 0 allows today only.
fields.label: Default Backdating for Everyone Else (Days)

fields.description: One row per doctype and per role or user. A doctype named by no row is not restricted at all. Administrator always may.
fields.label: Backdating Rules

fields.description: Let an amended document keep the date of the document it amends, however far back that is. Off: an amendment is judged like any other entry, so correcting an old document needs an allowance that reaches it. On either setting, moving the date further back than the original is still refused. Note that an amendment may change the amount, so leaving this on allows an old entry to be restated without one.
fields.label: Allow Amendments to Keep the Original Date

fields.description: Which documents the control covers. Leave empty to cover the standard accounting and stock vouchers (Journal Entry, Payment Entry, Sales and Purchase Invoice, Sales and Purchase Order, Delivery Note, Purchase Receipt, Stock Entry, Payment Advice). Anything named by a rule below is always covered as well. HR, payroll and period-close documents are deliberately not in the default set — add them here if you want them.
fields.label: Applies To These Documents

fields.description: Refuse a Sales Return raised outside the window below. Off, and nothing changes.
fields.label: Restrict Creating Sales Returns

fields.description: How many days a return may still be raised within. 0 allows the same day only.
fields.label: Days Allowed for a Return

fields.description: Counted from the invoice being returned (the usual retail rule), or from today back to the return's own posting date.
fields.label: Count the Days From
fields.options:
Original Invoice Date
Return Posting Date

fields.description: Roles or users who may raise a return past the window anyway.
fields.label: Allowed to Override
